visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with black hair in a high ponytail, dressed in a sleeveless white cheongsam (qipao) with large red rose patterns, stands in an outdoor garden setting. She holds a silver flute and begins playing it gracefully. The background consists of lush green bamboo leaves and a traditional brick wall under bright, natural daylight. (2) The scene cuts to a closer medium shot of the woman as she continues her performance, looking directly toward the camera with a focused expression. A musical score is displayed as a transparent overlay at the bottom of the frame. (3) She lowers the flute and places it behind her back, striking a playful pose and turning her head to smile at the camera. She then performs rhythmic arm movements, swaying her body to the beat of the music. (4) The woman resumes playing the flute briefly before transitioning into another playful pose, winking and smiling warmly at the viewer. The camera remains static throughout, capturing the interaction between the performer and the traditional setting.
